title: 3D Model Datapack Template
description: This is an template used to add 3D models to your game via heledron's text display model generator (by SyanicXD)
body:
This is a datapack template file for heledron's [Text Display Model Generator tool](https://heledron.com/tools/text-display-mesher/) featured in SyanicXD 's YouTube video.

This is used to import 3D Meshes as Text displays directly into the minecraft world.
